entities.summary: Centurion Air Cargo Flight 164 was a chartered international cargo flight, flying from Bogotá's El Dorado International Airport while en route to Miami International Airport. The flight was operated by Kalitta Air and the aircraft was wet leased by Centurion Air Cargo. On July 7, 2008, the aircraft, a Boeing 747-209BSF registered as N714CK, crashed shortly after takeoff. All aboard suffered injuries, but none were killed. Two people on the ground were killed after the plane slammed into a farm. The crash was the second crash of a Boeing 747 in 2008 in Kalitta Air service after a previous accident at Brussels in May.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: The crash of Centurion Air Cargo Flight 164 resulted in two fatalities on the ground and injuries to all 22 people on board. The incident highlighted concerns over cargo plane safety and led to increased regulatory scrutiny.
